candidate_093.name: physics-outcome-conditioned slip-to-forbid repair
candidate_093.mechanism_hypothesis: After each executed physical or physics-grounded evaluation, deterministically compare intended and realized configuration, translate a detected mismatch into an explicit prohibition or localized repair constraint for the next proposal, and block malformed/redundant proposals before spending the expensive evaluation budget. Keep convergence stopping separate so the repair loop can be evaluated independently from stopping policy.

primary_evidence.source: Zongmin Zhang et al., AdsMind: A Physics-Grounded Multi-Agent System for Self-Correcting Discovery of Adsorption Configurations on Heterogeneous Catalyst Surfaces, arXiv:2606.19152v1, submitted 2026-06-17.
primary_evidence.architecture: AdsMind detects Chemical Slip by comparing the planned adsorption site/binding mode with the MLFF-relaxed configuration, writes slip and bond-integrity diagnostics into running memory, converts slipped or unstable intents into explicit FORBID constraints for subsequent planning, validates schema/site/index consistency and duplicate hypotheses before relaxation, and uses a distinct convergence-based TERMINATE directive.
primary_evidence.matched_ablation: Under a frozen MACE-MP-0-small protocol across 62 OCD-GMAE62 cases and four LLM backends (248 attempted runs), Full achieved 245/248 success (98.8%) versus 222/248 (89.5%) for the open-loop 1-Shot ablation. Among successful same-backend pairs, 1-Shot had mean +0.329 eV energy penalty relative to Full and only 99/222 (44.6%) were within +/-0.05 eV of Full; w/o Term retained Slip+FORBID and had 191/245 (78.0%) within that band. Mean cross-backend energy range compressed from 0.316 eV in 1-Shot to 0.183 eV in Full.
primary_evidence.aa20_replication: On AA20, Full reached 100% workflow success with a mean 4.11 MLFF relaxations per case. Only 35/73 valid 1-Shot runs (47.9%; seven failed runs) were within +/-0.05 eV of Full, versus 63/80 (78.7%) for w/o Term. Across backends, 1-Shot Chemical Slip occurred in 61.5-76.9% of valid non-dissociated attempts on intermetallic surfaces and 40.0-80.0% on monometallic surfaces.
primary_evidence.first_principles_check: A six-system VASP/PBE check found no adsorption-energy sign mismatch for AdsMind, while the reported open-loop Adsorb-Agent outputs had sign mismatches in three of four non-H molecular cases; however the two workflows used different MLFF backends, so this is a physical-fidelity reference check rather than an architecture-only causal ablation.
primary_evidence.negative_boundary: Feedback constraints can over-constrain exploration: on OCD-GMAE62 case 008 with GPT-5.4, 1-Shot reached -8.47 eV while the Full feedback-constrained workflow converged to -7.48 eV, 0.99 eV worse. The mechanism should therefore retain an escape/reopen path rather than make FORBID constraints irreversible.
primary_evidence.control_relevance: This is direct materials-science evidence for mandatory evidence-changing repair: execution diagnostics do not merely produce reflective prose; they alter the subsequent admissible action set. It strengthens the open frontier on physical mandatory repair while also showing why repair constraints should be revocable or diversity-preserving.
primary_evidence.limits: The expensive evaluation is an ML force-field relaxation rather than a bench-top experiment, and the individual Chemical Slip versus FORBID contributions are only partially isolated in the main text; supporting-information component ablations should be extracted next.

wet_lab_supporting_evidence.source: Yankai Jiang et al., A Self-Evolving Agentic System for Automated Generation and Execution of Biological Protocols, arXiv:2606.31763, submitted 2026-06-30.
wet_lab_supporting_evidence.result: ProtoPilot spans 294 synthetic- and molecular-biology tasks from 98 gold-standard protocols, uses layer-wise verifiability and device-level validity gates, reports a 90.2% Top@3 expert-preference rate, 89.5% overall protocol-to-code gate pass rate and 88.24% Opentrons pass rate versus 32.35% for OpenTrons-AI, and physically revised a failed PCA DNA-assembly workflow to obtain sequence-validated targets.
wet_lab_supporting_evidence.scope: This is useful wet-lab support for layered validation plus feedback-guided revision, but no matched ablation isolating the gate or self-evolution mechanism was established in this invocation, so it is not promoted as an independent causal candidate yet.
